description.short_caption: Gram stain showing gram-positive rods in a chain-like arrangement.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of a specimen with gram-positive rods arranged in a chain-like formation. The rods are darkly stained, consistent with the Gram-positive nature, and are surrounded by a background of lighter-stained material. There are also amorphous reddish areas in the background, which may represent cellular debris or other material.
visible_findings: clear contrast between rods and background

description.short_caption: Skin lesions with varying stages of ulceration and discoloration on the lower limb.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the skin of a lower limb with multiple lesions. The lesions vary in appearance, including areas of erythema, hyperpigmentation, and ulceration. Some lesions appear crusted or necrotic, with a dark red to brown coloration, while others are more superficial with lighter discoloration. The surrounding skin appears pale and unremarkable. The distribution and morphology suggest a possible infectious or inflammatory etiology.
